announcements.headline: Leverage Shares plc - Termination of AP Agreement
announcements.insight: Leverage Shares plc terminates its AP agreement following the October broker dealer replacement. Shareholders should monitor for subsequent operational adjustments.

announcements.headline: Leverage Shares plc - Replacement Broker Dealer
announcements.insight: Leverage Shares plc appointed an authorised participant in September. The replacement broker dealer announcement follows this earlier step.

announcements.headline: Leverage Shares Appointment Authorised Participant
announcements.insight: This announcement signifies a governance change involving the appointment of an authorised participant, which is a standard operational requirement for exchange-traded products to ensure liquidity and market access. It does not indicate a material financial event or strategic shift, but rather confirms necessary structural arrangements for the vehicle's functioning.
